color.note: Kiln's palette: white ground, one near-black ink, greys for structure, one red. Every UI colour is one of these; the stage has its own palette (Form Skate Stage).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground of every surface: page, tiles, header bar, menus, inputs, the side column. There are no tinted panels: a new surface is bg separated by a 1 px hair rule.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Hover rows (menu items, shelf and contents entries, events, trace headers), inline code chips, the plain callout, figure fills (f-fill). Never a panel background.

tokens.name: fill-2
tokens.usage: The darker grey fill in figures (f-fill2) and sparkline areas. Rare in the UI.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and marks, on bg, fill, code-bg and panel. Also the fill of on/primary buttons and selected segments (with bg as their text), the focus outline, and the 1 px rules that mark structure (doc h2 rule, menu border, params top rule).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sub labels, counts, tab labels at rest, notes, placeholders, units, empty states, axis labels. On bg and code-bg in both themes; on fill it is 4.4:1 in light, so keep long text off fill.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Kiln's minor grid colour. Defined for other Kiln tools; Form Skate's own UI does not use it (the stage draws its grid with Form Skate Stage's st-grid).

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Kiln's major grid colour. Defined, unused by Form Skate's UI (see grid).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one red, and only for trouble and selection: errors and bails, the selected row's 2 px inset bar, the selected graph node, the Try it callout's rule, the ▸ after a lab: link, the chapter label, the text caret. As text on bg in both themes. Never decoration, never a brand colour.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Kiln's success colour, deliberately the same as ink: success is not coloured. Defined, unused in Form Skate's CSS.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Kiln's warning text in consoles. Defined, unused by Form Skate's views: warnings in the editor gutter are ink and bold instead.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Background of diagram areas (.diagram: the dataflow graph). Same as bg.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Background of boxes floating over a canvas (.ovl-box). Same as bg.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: The 1 px hairline: tile and bar borders, control borders at rest (buttons, segments, toggles, inputs), gutters between tiles, table header rules. A hairline is structure, not a control affordance: at rest it is about 1.5:1 on bg, below 3:1 (the source's look; hover turns a control's border to ink).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The faintest line: between rows of a list or table, under sub headers, the zero line of a trace.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of code: the editor, pre.src blocks, inputs that take code or names, the notes editor.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: A red wash: text selection in the editor, the line with an error, the Try it callout, the drop hint while dragging a tab, figure f-sel. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: tok-key
tokens.usage: Code: keywords, bold. On code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-str
tokens.usage: Code: strings, grey. On code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-num
tokens.usage: Code: numbers (and bold literals null, true, false). On code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-expr
tokens.usage: Code: the lambda arrow =>, red and bold: the only colour in code. On code-bg.

tokens.name: tok-com
tokens.usage: Code: comments (italic) and the line numbers in the gutter. On code-bg. Deliberately faint: about 2.4:1 in light and 3.3:1 in dark, below 4.5:1 (the source's choice; comments recede).

tokens.name: tok-punc
tokens.usage: Code: punctuation and operators. On code-bg. Faint like tok-com, below 4.5:1 by design.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the error toast and the stopped-runtime banner. The source writes it as a literal #fff in both themes; 4.9:1 on the light accent, 3.5:1 on the dark one (below 4.5:1).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Arial in two weights, 400 and 700. The stylesheet calls this family --mono (a name kept from Kiln); it is Arial, not a monospace.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: The default for every control, row and label (fs-s).

styles.name: ui-small
styles.usage: Sub labels, counts, notes, menu descriptions, kbd keys, small buttons (fs-xs). Usually ink-2.

styles.name: ui-tab
styles.usage: Tile tabs (fs-m); the active tab is 700 with a 1 px ink underline.

styles.name: block-title
styles.usage: A block's h2 in a side column or inspector (fs-m).

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The name in the header bar, followed by the word workbench in ui-small, 400, ink-2.

styles.name: project-title
styles.usage: The preset's title in the header's project button, after its code (B-01) in ui-small.

styles.name: pill-value
styles.usage: The value in a status pill (ok, 2 errors, a score), with tabular figures.

styles.name: bignum
styles.usage: One headline number in a side column (the score). Kiln's base rule is 30px (fs-xl); Form Skate's side column sets 26px.

styles.name: chapter-label
styles.usage: Uppercase, in accent: the label above a chapter title; in ink-2 above a part title.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Uppercase group headers in the shelf and the book contents, ink-2. Menu group headers use the same size without caps.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Notes, Docs, Reference and the Book render Markdown in .doc: 13.5px Arial at line height 1.65, at most 76 characters wide (74 in the Book, at 14px).

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: The stage is a drafting sheet, not a game camera.
styles.usage: Running text in Notes, Docs and Reference.

styles.name: book-body
styles.sample: A kickflip lasts half a second; a drawing of it lasts as long as anyone looks at it.
styles.usage: Running text in the Book (13.5px in a tile narrower than 700px).

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: A note's or doc's title. The paragraph right after it is the lede, 13px in ink-2.

styles.name: book-h1
styles.usage: A chapter title, under its chapter-label.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: Sections, with a 1 px ink rule above (17px in the Book). Three or more h2s make the contents line under the title.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: Subsections.

styles.name: doc-h4
styles.usage: Uppercase, ink-2: the headers of related lists (In the book, Presets that use this, Further reading on the shelf).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 47.1. The history samples around the running example.
styles.usage: Figure captions, ink-2, its leading bold Figure N.k in ink; at most 68 characters wide.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The system monospace (ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas). Code is never set in Arial.

styles.name: code-editor
styles.usage: The editor and its gutter: a fixed 18px line so the highlight layer and the textarea line up.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: pre.src blocks in reading views (10.5px in panels), the IR text (line height 1.6) and the events list (1.55).

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code in panels, on a fill chip. In reading views inline code is 0.9em of the text.

styles.name: code-name
styles.usage: A signal's or state's id as the title of a trace row.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Expression text in the inspector, source locations, event detail, logs (11px).

fontSize.note: Kiln's five font-size variables. The stylesheet uses them by name (var(--fs-s)); reading views set their own sizes (see Reading).

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Small text: sub labels, counts, notes, menu descriptions, small buttons, kbd.

tokens.name: fs-s
tokens.usage: The base size of the interface (body), buttons, rows, hints.

tokens.name: fs-m
tokens.usage: Tile tabs and block titles.

tokens.name: fs-l
tokens.usage: Detail titles. Rare in Form Skate.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: Kiln's big number. Form Skate's side column overrides it to 26px.

spacing.note: Kiln has no spacing scale: its rules write pixel values directly. These are the values it uses, named by size, with where each one appears. Rows are dense: 4 to 8px inside controls, 12 to 16px at the edges of a block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The gap inside tight lists (search results, event rows) and between a title and its small text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small-button vertical padding (3px 8px); the gap between trick pad cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Run controls gap; menu padding top and bottom; the tab strip's left inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (5px 10px); shelf entries and diagnostics (5px 12px or 14px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, toasts and inline items; toolbar vertical padding; the gap inside small groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Menu item vertical padding (7px 14px); toggle gap; toast vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The usual gap: toolbar, block header, block content, param rows, project button sides.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Button and pill side padding; the gap in menu items, footers and event rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Header bar gap; block top padding; toolbar, footer and list-row side padding; a tab's left padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Menu item, shelf, contents and hint side padding; side-column block sides; toast sides.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The standard side inset of a block, param row and header bar.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: A doc's top padding; the gap above a figure's caption block.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: The empty-tile picker's padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: A doc's side padding (18px 22px 64px).

radius.note: Square. Nothing in the workbench has rounded corners except two marks: the radio dot in menus and the signals group in the graph (rx 10).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every button, input, segment, menu, tile, callout, toast and table. Write border-radius: 0 explicitly on controls so the browser's default rounding does not appear.

size.note: Heights and widths the stylesheet repeats.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: The header bar.

tokens.name: strip-h
tokens.usage: A tile's tab strip, and the file tabs bar in Code.

tokens.name: toolbar-min-h
tokens.usage: The toolbar at the top of a view (min-height; it wraps).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Segments, toggles, pills, filter inputs and selects in a toolbar.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small segments (.seg.sm).

tokens.name: icon-btn
tokens.usage: Icon buttons (.ibtn), square; 28px in the run controls, 26px in the agent header.

tokens.name: hint-h
tokens.usage: The one-line hint bar under the stage.

tokens.name: row-min-h
tokens.usage: A parameter row.

tokens.name: editor-gutter
tokens.usage: The code editor's line-number gutter.

tokens.name: side-w
tokens.usage: A view's side column (inspector, stage side panel).

tokens.name: shelf-w
tokens.usage: The Docs shelf.

tokens.name: contents-w
tokens.usage: The Book's contents column.

tokens.name: doc-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of reading text (.doc).

tokens.name: book-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a chapter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every rule and border. Lines are the only structure.

tokens.name: line-mark
tokens.usage: Marks of state: the selected row's inset bar, a callout's left rule, the focus outline, an active thread's underline.

tokens.name: line-part
tokens.usage: The rule above a part title in the Book, the heaviest line in the system.
